The data is live. A real generated itinerary for Lisbon, live geocoding as you type, and live POI search from OpenStreetMap — no fixtures, no lorem, no placeholder prices. The design system is Kiln, shipped 2026-09-08 and documented in DESIGN.md.

Changing it3

Two ways in, both conversational.

How to read the palette. Three colours, one meaning each: jade acts and only acts, gold counts money and only money, coral is kept for something that cannot happen. Everything else is warm paper on a single near-black slate. If a screen here seems to break that, it is worth saying — that is exactly what this board is for.

One thing already known. One screen is still absent — the generation screen, because capturing it means spending a real model run.

Every screen here was re-shot for this round. Five are new: Home while a trip is running, the same screen with no network, the saved-places split, the computed repairs on their own, and the plan offline. Two previous rounds of outside feedback read earlier versions of this board as the whole product and reasonably concluded that what it did not show did not exist — a third of the first round asked for things that were already built and merely unphotographed. So for anything that still looks missing: name the screen you would expect it on, and ask, rather than inferring absence from a picture.

Two things left open last round are now changed, on the reviewer's argument rather than mine. Pace no longer prints three answers on one line, and emoji are gone from the generation prompt — the case that won was that this product has a deliberately small visual vocabulary and pictographs in generated prose are a fourth one nobody designed. The third, the category rail's scroll affordance, both of us agreed to leave to evidence rather than instinct.

What the last round actually changed is the class of thing being looked for. It was run as a truthfulness audit, and every finding was a surface speaking above its evidence — an invented forecast, a count that implied exhaustiveness, a database row presented as a guarantee. Two turned out to be worse in the code than in the photograph. The most useful question to ask of this board is still that one: where does it claim more than it knows?

Known to be unresolved. Stops carry no provenance, so a historical fact, a computed estimate and a generated suggestion all arrive in the same voice — that is the next cycle. And plans generated before this round keep their emoji and their invented weather prose in storage; the prompt stops new ones, and the client refuses to render the old ones as fact, but the strings are still on disk.
